fixed.member: og cook: normal and linear textures
fixed.summary: UASTC textures (normal maps, metallic-roughness, occlusion, masks, and colour under `cook { color_textures uastc }`) encode at level 1 without rate-distortion optimisation instead of level 3 with RDO 1.0: about 14 times faster to cook (a 2048² normal map 8.9 s instead of 129 s on one thread) at equal or higher PSNR and about 10 % more bytes. Every UASTC texture cooks again once.
